selected_approach: Keep the existing atomic ledger and add explicit workflow protocol2 with legacy task interpretation, executable task plans, role selection and three-round debate, change requests, research evidence/novelty records, improvement records and common runtime adapters.
alternatives: Documentation-only additions: rejected because they do not execute controls or exercise state transitions.
Replace storage and migrate history: rejected because the current transactional ledger is working and SHA-bound evidence must survive.
Add a hosted model orchestration service: deferred; current local trust model has no credentials, authenticated identity or distributed scheduling.

round1.solution: Add governance/orchestration modules behind the existing Project transactional interface.
assumptions: Trusted local filesystem and contributor identities
risks: Historical approvals must not be interpreted retroactively
Consensus must bind stable spec/source/policy/assignment/evidence inputs

round1.solution: Explicit protocol version independent of schema1; mandatory evidence-bound task plans and major debate consensus plus review gates.
assumptions: Capability labels are declarations rather than authentication
risks: Generated debate state could invalidate itself
Role coverage alone could hide one-label quorum

round1.solution: Structured literature sources/access, seven-field ideas, and independent candidate/overlap/inconclusive audits tied to content fingerprints.
assumptions: Read scope and unavailable data are preserved
risks: Full-text metadata alone cannot prove literature search completeness or scientific novelty
Fixture data must not imply wetlab or publication success

round2.challenge: Current generated context misses compatibility/runtime/change policies; package data may omit hidden nested directories. Frozen proposal plus live assignments/capabilities and evidence must be validated; every participant analyzes and challenges another before voting; >=2 independent reviewers; contributor history persists. Request changes cannot disappear by relabeling.
round2.resolution: Add explicit packaged hidden assets and governed context inputs; separate stable fingerprints from generated reports, require role/capability snapshot validity and all rounds, preserve dissent, and test stale selection/reviews. Legacy tests explicitly select protocol1; fresh init defaults protocol2.

round2.challenge: Novelty controls could falsely treat unavailable search or a synthetic calibration fixture as proof of a scientific gap.
round2.resolution: Require truthful access metadata and source/evidence checks; unavailable or abstract-only coverage cannot support candidate novelty, overlap and inconclusive remain valid review outcomes. Record logical-day switching as simulation and do not claim external product invocation.

remaining_risks: No OS sandbox or authenticated identities
No model/provider invocation in selection; adapters provide executable workflow contracts and dispatch packets
No distributed consensus or external hash anchor
Full-state events remain costly for large histories
Cross-platform CI must be distinguished from actual execution
acceptance: Preserve all baseline event hashes and referenced Phase1 evidence
Legacy 40 tests plus new gate/round/staleness/research/upgrade tests
Three real executed CLI/state scenarios and independently reviewed final results
New wheel includes all hidden/nested protocol files; isolated install and clone/rebuild succeed
